The '''''Jagged Fel''''' was a [[Pellaeon-class Star Destroyer|''Pellaeon''-class Star Destroyer]] in the [[Empire-in-exile]] resistance, named after [[Jagged Fel]], founder of the [[Fel dynasty]] and first [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] of the Fel Empire. It served as the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of the Empire after the [[Attack on the Hidden Temple]] and was stationed over [[Bastion/Legends|Bastion]].

It was part of the combined fleet of the Fel Empire, the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]] and the remnants of the [[New Jedi Order]] at the [[Battle of Coruscant (Second Imperial Civil War)|Battle of Coruscant]], under the command of Emperor [[Roan Fel]], Jagged Fel's grandson.

The ship contained at least one secret compartment for high priority prisoners. [[Darth Maladi]] was held in one such cell.
